parts.label: Cellulose cell wall
parts.info: Rigid wall that supports the cell and resists bursting.

parts.label: Cell membrane
parts.info: Controls entry and exit of substances; pressed against the wall.

parts.label: Large central vacuole
parts.info: Stores cell sap and keeps the cell turgid; bounded by the tonoplast.

parts.label: Nucleus
parts.info: Holds the DNA; often pushed to the side by the vacuole.

parts.label: Grana (thylakoid stacks)
parts.info: Hold chlorophyll; where the light-dependent reactions happen.

parts.label: Mitochondria
parts.info: Aerobic respiration; plant cells have them as well as chloroplasts.

parts.label: Golgi apparatus
parts.info: Processes proteins and makes cell-wall polysaccharides.

parts.label: Plasmodesmata
parts.info: Channels through the wall linking the cytoplasm of neighbouring cells.
